import HexPrimality.Elab
import HexIntFactor.Primality

open Lean Hex.PrimalityTactic

-- Let the finite construction allocation finish independently of elaboration fuel.
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  unless constructionExtensionNames == [`HexIntFactor.PrimalityTactic.constructionExtension] do
    throwError "the current construction portfolio changed; update the comparator"
  let (result, allocations) ← construct 69199437377629051939477864552334532767081794053034238723740032946332041487367 Hex.Nat.constructionBudget
  unless allocations.any (fun (name, _) => name == ``Hex.Nat.ecmConstructionFactor) do
    throwError "ECM extension was not tried"
  match result with
  | .ok _ => throwError "expected full construction exhaustion for 69199437377629051939477864552334532767081794053034238723740032946332041487367"
  | .error f =>
    unless f.stop == .exhausted && f.attempts == 170 do
      throwError "construction outcome changed for 69199437377629051939477864552334532767081794053034238723740032946332041487367"
    logInfo "FULL_CONSTRUCTION tuning-256-0: exhausted after {f.attempts} attempts"
  let (result, allocations) ← construct 58462043247721851837374720714032783167040048430751222127700100782042467564843 Hex.Nat.constructionBudget
  unless allocations.any (fun (name, _) => name == ``Hex.Nat.ecmConstructionFactor) do
    throwError "ECM extension was not tried"
  match result with
  | .ok _ => throwError "expected full construction exhaustion for 58462043247721851837374720714032783167040048430751222127700100782042467564843"
  | .error f =>
    unless f.stop == .exhausted && f.attempts == 189 do
      throwError "construction outcome changed for 58462043247721851837374720714032783167040048430751222127700100782042467564843"
    logInfo "FULL_CONSTRUCTION tuning-256-1: exhausted after {f.attempts} attempts"
  let (result, allocations) ← construct 69720056183201689673043526946867998580043318488979852658170286968852334279321 Hex.Nat.constructionBudget
  unless allocations.any (fun (name, _) => name == ``Hex.Nat.ecmConstructionFactor) do
    throwError "ECM extension was not tried"
  match result with
  | .ok _ => throwError "expected full construction exhaustion for 69720056183201689673043526946867998580043318488979852658170286968852334279321"
  | .error f =>
    unless f.stop == .exhausted && f.attempts == 201 do
      throwError "construction outcome changed for 69720056183201689673043526946867998580043318488979852658170286968852334279321"
    logInfo "FULL_CONSTRUCTION tuning-256-2: exhausted after {f.attempts} attempts"
  let (result, allocations) ← construct 79115478805960826808549622107591358196461499795534342671326167515356343483999 Hex.Nat.constructionBudget
  unless allocations.any (fun (name, _) => name == ``Hex.Nat.ecmConstructionFactor) do
    throwError "ECM extension was not tried"
  match result with
  | .ok _ => throwError "expected full construction exhaustion for 79115478805960826808549622107591358196461499795534342671326167515356343483999"
  | .error f =>
    unless f.stop == .exhausted && f.attempts == 156 do
      throwError "construction outcome changed for 79115478805960826808549622107591358196461499795534342671326167515356343483999"
    logInfo "FULL_CONSTRUCTION holdout-256-1: exhausted after {f.attempts} attempts"
